name: Baby Care Urine Alarm
description:
Baby Urine Alarm 
Alarm unit size: 8cm x 5.2cm x2.3cm 
Microcomputer control with intelligent design, Multi-alarm modes for you to select easily, including music, vibration and multi-LED light 
High sensitivity and accuracy 
Low power consumption 
Low battery indicator 
Easy to use, one button operation to set up 
Powered by 2x AAA batteries. (Batteries not provided, please use normal battery, not suitable for rechargeable battery)
